title: A Perfectly Located, Nashville Favorite! 5 Stars!
description:
Experience our custom-built downtown Nashville retreat, boasting an open floor plan, fully equipped kitchen, and luxurious king beds. Just minutes from Broadway and other hotspots, it's the perfect base for your Nashville adventure.

The space
“The living room has an open floor plan with vaulted ceilings and large windows which gives the space a roomy and airy feel.”

“The bedrooms are large enough to fit king beds while still providing ample room to move around. Not to mention the large walk in closets”

“The space is well designed, decorated, clean and cozy”

Guest access
Guests enjoy full privacy with exclusive access to the house, including designated parking spots and a private entrance. The entire living space is situated on the 2nd floor. Prior to check-in, guests will receive a unique door code for seamless access."
